detect.note: PKHeX reads the general block's size and magic from slot B, the slot a game saves to first. It tries Diamond and Pearl's size first.

pk4.note: A stored Pokémon after pk45-crypt, its blocks in the order A, B, C, D.

ranges.note: Bits 28 to 31 are unused.

ranges.name: Items pocket
ranges.note: PKHeX reads the first 162 slots, one for each item the pocket takes.

ranges.name: Key items pocket
ranges.note: PKHeX reads the first 40, one for each key item.

ranges.name: Medicine pocket
ranges.note: PKHeX reads the first 38, one for each medicine.

ranges.name: Battle items pocket
ranges.note: PKHeX reads the first 13 slots, one for each battle item. The pocket's other slots run to the event work at 0x0DAC.

ranges.name: Event flags
ranges.note: 2,912 flags.

ranges.name: Pokétch app unlocked
ranges.note: One byte per app, from the Digital Watch to the Alarm Clock.

ranges.name: Pokédex owned flags
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n, for 1 to 493. The last byte holds the Deoxys forms seen, with the last byte of the seen flags.

ranges.name: Pokédex seen flags
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n, for 1 to 493. The last byte holds the Deoxys forms seen, with the last byte of the owned flags.

ranges.name: Pokédex first gender seen
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n: 0 for male, 1 for female.

ranges.name: Pokédex second gender seen
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n. It differs from the first gender's bit once both genders are seen.

ranges.name: Daycare Pokémon
ranges.note: Encrypted like a boxed Pokémon (pk45-crypt).

ranges.name: Underground: flags taken from the player's base
Underground: times the secret base moved
Accessory counts
ranges.note: Four bits per accessory that can be held more than once.

ranges.name: Accessories owned
ranges.note: One bit per accessory held once at most.

ranges.name: Backdrop positions
ranges.note: 18 for a backdrop not unlocked.

ranges.name: Groups
ranges.note: The player's group, the group the player is in, then four from other players.

ranges.name: Records
ranges.note: Encrypted. PKHeX decrypts them.

ranges.name: Seals
ranges.note: How many of each seal the player has.

ranges.name: Roamer location
ranges.note: Mesprit, Cresselia, a third the game doesn't use, then Moltres, Zapdos and Articuno.

ranges.name: Mystery Gift received flags
ranges.note: Flag 2047 is the deliveryman being at the Pokémon Center.

ranges.name: Magic
ranges.note: 0x20060623, or 0x20070903 in the Korean games.

ranges.name: Box names

wallpaper.note: Platinum stores its special wallpapers 8 higher than PKHeX numbers them.

location.note: Platinum writes the met location to met-location-extended too, and keeps Faraway Place here for a place Diamond and Pearl don't have.

hatch-counter.note: An egg keeps its hatch counter in the friendship byte.
